freecamplus.config.comment.lockDirection: In the free camera: blocks keep the direction of your last placement (or the camera's, if you haven't placed yet) while the camera looks around. Press again to follow the camera again.
freecamplus.config.comment.lockSneak: In the free camera: every click from the camera is a sneaking click (placing against chests and other blocks you can open places instead of opening them) until you press it again. Your character itself does not sneak: it does not crouch and does not sink while flying, and turning it on clicks nothing.
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.tweakeroo: Adds waypoints, an adjustable sprint speed and a pointer back to your character to Tweakeroo's free camera. Middle-click sets or removes a waypoint, Ctrl + mouse wheel changes the sprint speed, and a triple tap on Ctrl points at your character.
